name: n8n-nodes-trustmarkt
description: n8n community node for integrating with the Trustmarkt API to manage reviews, review collectors, leads, resources (lead magnets), users, articles, case studies, inquiries, and webhooks

scripts.publish:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm run lint && npm publish --access public --ignore-scripts
scripts.publish:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm run lint && npm publish --access public --ignore-scripts
scripts.publish:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm run lint && npm publish --access public --ignore-scripts
